## Checklist

- [ ] It's one change. Bigger ones were agreed in an issue or discussion first.
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint` and `bun test packages apps` pass.
- [ ] New logic has tests; a bug fix has a test that failed before it.
- [ ] It follows [the conventions](https://github.com/HelloboxGH/hellobox/blob/main/docs/CONVENTIONS.md).
- [ ] If it breaks something for people running HelloBox, the commit body has a `Breaking:` line saying what they must do.
- [ ] No secrets, customer names or private URLs in the code, commits or this description.
